contexts.text: It has been granted me to speak with all I had ever known... after they had died...
All who... have died are either in Heaven or Hell. General article.
No one has thought of any distance in space when I have told him that I had spoken with some one who had died in Asia, Africa, or Europe...
No one is reformed through visions and speech with the dead, because they force. General article.
Two (such married partners) are not separated by the death of one of them, for the spirit of the departed one constantly dwells with the spirit of the one who has not yet departed.
By novitiate Spirits are meant men newly deceased...
This commandment means... that no man, dead or living, shall be worshipped as a god.

1. It has pleased the Lord... to grant me to speak face to face with Angels and deceased men; to survey them, touch them, and tell them many things about the incredulity and fallacy of men now living...
4. I have spoken with some deceased persons, who were then Spirits, on the third day after (their death).
The reason there appears so strong a likeness with those who are recently deceased, is that their mind remains the same...
